model.description: Unreal asset path. Empty in M1.

default_skin.description: Skin id for the form's default look. Must be made for the form's base.

cost.description: For earn: the farming target (fragments or spectrum to collect).

spectrum.description: Price in the item's own Spectrum (soft currency earned in play).

prisms.description: Price in Prisms (premium currency, a mix of all spectrums).

skip.description: Prices to skip farming. Required when type is earn. Every form (morph) that is earned must have both prices.

base.description: A node in the body-type tree. Usually a subcategory. Sets skeleton and shared animations.

extra_animations.description: Form-specific animations on top of the base set.

starter.description: True if the player can inhabit this form as the first form (the opening). Starter forms are never sold. The one the player picks is granted in setup. The others are earned in play (unlock type earn).

limited.description: Limited morphs (pass or event exclusives) are NOT sold in the market by default.

approved_by.description: Only Ziyue Li may approve selling a limited morph in the market.

prisms.description: Market price in Prisms for a limited morph that Ziyue allows in the market.

market_override.description: Allows a limited morph in the market. Needs Ziyue's approval.
